items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 — Google's open 740M embedding model adds images, audio and video
items.summary: One small open model that turns text, code, pictures, sound and video into vectors you can search together, on device.

items.title: Cyber Verification Program — Anthropic opens three tiers of cyber access to Claude
items.summary: Verified defenders and red teams can now get Claude with fewer cyber blocks, sorted into three access levels.

items.title: REA 4.1 — the agent reverse-engineering kit now reads Android APKs and firmware
items.summary: Point your coding agent at an app or binary and it can decompile it, trace a feature and show the evidence.

items.title: Mistral Large 4 — a 1T multimodal MoE with 49B active and 1M context
items.summary: Mistral's biggest model yet: a 1T-parameter multimodal MoE for coding, agents and security work.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Holo4: A Model That Clicks, Codes and Calls Tools'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen walks through Holo4, an open model built to operate software for you.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.290 — WebFetch reads past 100K characters, /loop survives compaction
items.summary: Claude Code stops losing long web pages and scheduled tasks, and gives mods more to read.

items.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video — open MIT models make video with synced speech and sound
items.summary: An open video model family that generates picture and sound together, with lip-sync, under the MIT license.

items.title: Dust — Q Labs pretrains transformers without backpropagation
items.summary: A search-based way to train transformers that gets close to backprop without computing a single backward pass.

items.title: Beam — Reflection's 501B open-weight MoE for coding and agents
items.summary: Reflection AI's first open-weight model: a 501B MoE built for coding, reasoning and agent workloads.

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5 agents find two room-temperature magnetic semiconductors
items.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 agents ran quantum simulations and found two candidate materials for faster, low-interference memory.

items.title: Fireship — 'PewDiePie is setting AI free... and OpenAI is furious'
items.summary: Fireship looks at Ajax, PewDiePie's home-trained uncensored model, and his clash with OpenAI.

items.title: OpenAI textGrain — invisible text watermarks for the EU AI Act
items.summary: OpenAI starts marking AI-written text in the EU and lets any API customer turn the same watermark on.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'The Billion Dollar AI Advantage Is Disappearing'
items.summary: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér asks what a cheaper Claude that nearly matches Opus means for the frontier.

items.title: Kevin Liao — agents don't need memory, they need documentation
items.summary: Why a Markdown 'brain' of specs and decisions beats a vector database of chat snippets for coding agents.

items.title: Strata v0.1.39 — Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B on a 12 GB gaming GPU
items.summary: A one-click engine that splits a 125B open model across your GPU, RAM, CPU and SSD so it runs on a normal gaming PC.

items.title: Muse Spark math papers — Meta's model helps settle five open problems
items.summary: Mathematicians used Meta's Muse Spark in an ordinary chat window to answer five open problems across six papers.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Which is The Best Qwen3.8-27B?'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen tests which Qwen3.8-27B fine-tune thinks less without losing accuracy.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'OpenAI's employee's WARNING'
items.summary: Wes Roth walks through a week of OpenAI safety warnings, from a resignation to a model planning for its own shutdown.

items.title: David Robinson quits OpenAI — a safety lead says its culture is broken
items.summary: One of OpenAI's longest-serving safety staff says the company ships too fast to be careful enough.

items.title: Simon Willison — usage-billed services need hard budget caps by default
items.summary: A warning email is not a limit: services should pause at your budget unless you opt out.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.289 — deny rules now catch env-prefixed shell commands
items.summary: Claude Code tightens its shell permission rules and makes plugins and mods fail alone instead of ending the session.

items.title: Strands Decider 2B — AWS opens a local decision model for agents
items.summary: A 2B open model that answers choice, yes/no and rating questions with a confidence score, fast enough to run before every agent step.

items.title: Kolibri — Aleph Alpha's open-weight German-English model
items.summary: A 78B open-weight MoE model trained in Germany and Finland, tuned for German and English reasoning.

items.title: Ataraxos — an $8,000 AI beats the best Stratego player 15-1
items.summary: A self-play AI masters Stratego, a game of hidden pieces, for about 1/500th of DeepNash's compute.

items.title: One month on GLM-5.3-Flash — the Wagtail team's open-model coding test
items.summary: A month-long attempt to do all coding work on one efficient open-weight model, with real token and cost numbers.
